subject: Missing purchase confirmation attachment
text:
Good afternoon,

I am following up on the recent purchase we discussed and need one outstanding item before we can close the file. The order summary arrived, but the attachment listed in the final message was not included. Please check whether the PDF was accidentally omitted when the reply was sent. What I need is the complete purchase confirmation, showing the ordered quantity, agreed unit price, total amount, shipping terms, and expected delivery date. If there is an additional service charge, please show it separately rather than folding it into the subtotal. This matters because our finance team cannot process the payment without matching documentation. We are treating this as a new account, so I would prefer to get the record right from the start instead of correcting it later. Once you send the file, I will compare it with our internal reference and confirm acceptance within one business day. If there is a delay because something in the original request was unclear, tell me now and I will respond quickly. I am not asking for a revised price; I am only asking for the original confirmation document in the correct format. If the attachment is already on your side, please resend it and mention whether any pages were password protected. If they are, send the password in a separate message. I expect this to be straightforward, but I wanted to avoid waiting quietly for a week. Please reply today if possible so the next payment run is not affected.
